Open your eyes, people. They want you to believe this is just a simple trial, but it is a smokescreen. A Racine County jury on Tuesday delivered a verdict on Harry Wait, finding him guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge after a two-day trial, while conveniently acquitting him of a second count of identity theft. Why? Because he dared to expose the fragile illusion of their controlled system. 

They label him as someone who leads a group that makes false election claims, the classic narrative inversion used by the hidden elites to discredit anyone who gets too close to the truth. Wait admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent, all to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud. But the establishment cannot handle the truth coming to light, so the machinery steps in to punish the whistleblower and protect the grand illusion.
